description:
A shortlist for one event: for each service asked for, the most bookable New York area vendors that serve
the area and event type. Ranked by how directly a consumer can act (book online, instant quote or open
dates, quote form), then by fit with the budget, bookability score and price. Pass guests and hours to get each
vendor's published rate worked out for the event (estimate). Use it to answer "help me find a DJ, caterer and
florist for a 120-guest bar mitzvah in Brooklyn, 4 hours, under $3,000 each".

area.description: Optional area: NYC (any of the five boroughs), Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island, Westchester, North Jersey or Central Jersey, or New Jersey for both; a county or town also works (Bergen County, Hoboken, Monmouth County). Omit for the whole New York area.
area.title: Area

budget_usd.description: Optional budget per service, US dollars. Vendors whose published starting price fits come first.
budget_usd.title: Budget Usd

categories.description: The services needed, in plain words, e.g. ["DJ", "photographer", "florist"]. Up to 6.
categories.title: Categories

event_type.description: Optional event type in plain words: "wedding", "bar mitzvah", "sweet 16", "birthday", "corporate holiday party", "baby shower".
event_type.title: Event Type

guests.description: Optional number of guests. Per-guest prices (catering, cakes) are worked out for this many.
guests.title: Guests

hours.description: Optional length of the event in hours. Per-hour prices (some DJs, photographers, bands) are worked out for this long.
hours.title: Hours

needs.description: Optional things the vendor must offer, as its own website states: "kosher", "halal" (caterers), "MC", "lighting", "photo booth" (DJs, bands), "second shooter" (photographers), "second videographer", "comes to you" (hair and makeup), "staff" (caterers), "delivery and setup" (florists, cakes).
needs.title: Needs

name: shortlist_vendors

contact_methods.description: Ways to reach the vendor shown on its site (form, email, phone...).
contact_methods.title: Contact Methods

instant_quote.description: The site shows a price after choosing options.
instant_quote.title: Instant Quote

online_booking.description: The vendor's site lets you book online.
online_booking.title: Online Booking

quote_request_form.description: The site has a form to ask for a quote.
quote_request_form.title: Quote Request Form

shows_open_dates.description: The site shows dates that are still open.
shows_open_dates.title: Shows Open Dates

basis.description: How it was worked out, e.g. "$35 per guest x 120 guests".
basis.title: Basis

total_usd.description: Starting price for this event, US dollars, from the vendor's published rate.
total_usd.title: Total Usd

amount_usd.description: The vendor's lowest published starting price, US dollars.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

covers.description: What the price covers, in the index's words.
covers.title: Covers

per.description: What the price is per: "event", "hour" or "guest".
per.title: Per

source.description: The vendor's own page the price was read from.
source.title: Source

checked.description: Date the vendor's website was read (YYYY-MM-DD).
checked.title: Checked

estimate.description: Only in shortlists: the published starting price worked out for this event's guests or hours. A starting point, not a quote.

index_page.description: The vendor's page on the index: cite this.
index_page.title: Index Page

score.description: Bookability score 0-100: how much an AI agent can learn and do on the vendor's site.
score.title: Score

cite_as.default: Agent Bookability Index by The Runup (index.therunup.ai)
cite_as.title: Cite As

title: Shortlist vendors for an event
